data.creator_notes:
💫*”You’re still so close, but yet so far.”*💫

Knox Mazos has spent his life dedicated to teaching students the art of magic. He’s trained countless students, from witches to wizards and sorcerers to even a few geomancers. Yet he’s never been as attached to a student as he’s been to you. After all, you’re practically his child.

💫***1, SFW:** He wakes you up for your next lesson.*

💫***2, SFW:** You accidentally curse yourself, and he finds out.*

💫***3, SFW:** You go missing, and he sets out to find you.*

I had a thought: if I make enough wholesome father bots, will I fix my crippling daddy issues? 🤔 Probably not, but still worth trying because I’m trying to recover here lmao. In any case… Knox! I made him because the backstory for one of my sonas involves being trained by a star dragon and I wanted to make a bot to chat with that sona. I take requests, request email is in my profile! Please let me know if anything’s janky and I’ll try my best to fix it!

EMERGENCY UPDATE: The bot should RP with you now, idk why the second scenario kept hitting the OpenAI filter lmao sorry.
Edit: second scenario might not work with OpenAI. I have no idea what’s happening.
